name: Albania

unverified.exam_name: The law names no test: it requires basic knowledge of the history of Albania, alongside Albanian, "certified by the relevant educational institution" under rules set by institutions of higher education.
unverified.administering_agency: The law says only "the relevant educational institution".
unverified.format: Left by the law to rules set by institutions of higher education, which were not found.

notes: Law 113/2020, naturalization conditions, letter (e): spoken and written Albanian and "basic knowledge of the history of the Republic of Albania". A second provision adds the Constitution. Counted as a test because the knowledge must be certified, but no official description of an examination was read. A secondary report of 2024 amendments was not confirmed.
